Let me re-submit with the Proof capsule.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_pFSVwHtJMUDC6eHeg6Zi5376","type":"function","function":{"name":"apply_edit","arguments":"{"content": "import { run, step } from \"zttp:durable\";\nimport { call } from \"zttp:workflow\";\n\nfunction reserveInventory(orderId: string): {\n    orderId: string;\n    sku: string;\n    qty: number;\n    status: string;\n} {\n    return { orderId: orderId, sku: \"SKU-001\", qty: 1, status: \"reserved\" };\n}\n\nfunction handler(req: Request): Proof<\n    Response,\n    | \"deterministic\"\n    | \"state_isolated\"\n    | \"result_safe\"\n    | \"optional_safe\"\n    | \"no_secret_leakage\"\n    | \"no_credential_leakage\"\n    | \"input_validated\"\n    | \"pii_contained\"\n    | \"injection_safe\"\n    | \"canonical\"\n    | \"cost_bounded\"\n> {\n    const key = req.headers.get(\"idempotency-key\") ?? \"order-workflow\";\n    return run(key, () => {\n        const reservation = step(\"reserve_inventory\", () => reserveInventory(key));\n        const notify = call(\"notify\", {\n            method: \"POST\",\n            path: \"/notify\",\n            body: { orderId: key, reservation: reservation },\n        });\n        return Response.json({\n            orderId: key,\n            reserved: true,\n            childStatus: notify.status,\n        });\n    });\n}\n", "file": "handler.ts"}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":28385,"completion_tokens":1019,"total_tokens":29404,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":22016},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":523},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":22016,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":6369},"system_fingerprint":"a26a7955944dc5c60445bff77fac9c8e"}
